body.prompt:
I'm making concept art for a cooperative board game called Stewards of the Long Voyage: Great Houses steward a vast generation ship; generations of leaders rise and retire. Style: RETRO SPACE — a 1950s pulp science-fiction paperback cover come to life. Gouache painting with flat colour and soft painted gradients, halftone-dot shading, chunky outlines, chrome highlights, rocket fins, atomic starbursts, ringed planets, mid-century modern interiors, a cheerful key light. People are sincere, not parody; the stakes are real. Palette: deep teal (#0F3A48), turquoise (#3AB0A8), tangerine (#E8603A), mustard gold (#F6C85A), cream (#FBEFD6), pink (#E88AA0), lime (#A8C860). Never put any text, letters, logos, borders or watermarks in the images.

Wide landscape image, exactly the layout of the attached guide, filling the frame edge to edge. Repaint the guide as a finished house player board for this game, flat and straight-on like a printed board-game mat. The tall banner on the left is the house's identity and the hero of the board: a heraldic hanging banner on a brass rod, straight sides and a swallowtail foot, exactly the shape in the guide, in electric blue (#3A6FD8) with a thin gold border, and a bold, simple emblem centred in its upper half, readable from across a table: a lightning bolt striking through a cog, crackling sparks, electric blue. The emblem is graphic and iconic, 1950s atomic-age style, with chrome and gold accents, no people. Keep every other shape exactly where it is and exactly as large as it is, and leave it empty for text: the name bar at the top, three growth cards, two tracks of round sockets on chrome rails, a wide panel bottom left and a narrow panel bottom right. Panels and sockets stay plain empty cream. The board around them is deep teal with a very subtle, low-contrast tone-on-tone pattern that hints at the house's power, like a faint watermark that never competes with the panels: faint arcing electrical traces and circuit lines. A thin line of electric blue (#3A6FD8) along the board edge. No people, no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
